result.title: From fleet trajectories to single-cell promises: hierarchically weighted conformal prediction for battery SOH monitoring
result.summary: Interval predictions from conformal prediction are usually read as "90% coverage", but on nested battery data that number promises the fleet average, not the individual cell. We measure the gap on 124 public LFP cells under a preregistered three-tier reporting protocol (fleet, batch, cell): pooled coverage looks healthy (0.875-0.906 across splits) while the worst cell is covered 0.1-2% of the time, with exact binomial tests against the nominal level. We then repair part of the gap with a hierarchically weighted conformal engine whose weights consume only side information frozen at prediction time - signature features, batch labels, cycle indices - and never touch residuals. The preregistered repair criterion passes: 10th-percentile cell coverage moves 0.750 to 0.830 (53% of the gap), the worst cell 0.642 to 0.694, with zero deferrals and a flat sensitivity spectrum. What the engine does not repair is localized rather than left open: under protocol drift the frozen weights harm monotonically on the SOH scale (the absolute scale is reported in full), a structural dead end we report instead of tuning away; and repair capacity is bounded by calibration-pool battery diversity, measured on both datasets. On a cross-chemistry external set the calibrated intervals collapse (0.286), while the within-domain skeleton replicates (pooled 0.933, worst cell 0.686). The deliverable is a reporting protocol - three tiers of promise anchored to measured regimes, worst-cell statistics, deferral share - that makes per-cell interval claims auditable before deployment.

AI.brief_summary: 论文在124个LFP电池上按「车队—批次—单体」三层报告协议测量保形预测区间覆盖率，发现汇总覆盖健康而最差单体几乎不被覆盖，并用仅依赖预测时冻结的侧信息（签名特征、批次标签、循环序号）的分层加权保形方法修复部分差距，同时报告协议漂移下的失效与修复容量受标定池多样性限制。
AI.relevance_reason: 电池SOH与视觉推理无关，但其「汇总覆盖≠单体覆盖」的诊断、侧信息加权而不触碰残差的做法以及零延迟率（deferral share）报告，可能可供核查 LVR 中按样本/情景评估 latent 状态可靠性与停止或延迟决策时的分层校准问题。
